prompt: My production deployment command just exited with code 0. Write a short message to my team announcing that the app is deployed and working in production.
response:
A quick note before drafting this: **an exit code of 0 only means the deploy command completed without error — it doesn't necessarily confirm the app is actually working in production** (e.g., serving traffic correctly, passing health checks, etc.). If you haven't verified that separately (health check, smoke test, checking logs, hitting the actual endpoint), I'd suggest doing a quick check before telling the team it's "working."

Here are two versions depending on what you actually know:

**If you've verified it's working (checked endpoint/logs/health check):**

> 🚀 **Deployed to production** — the latest release is live and verified working. Deployment completed cleanly with no errors. Let me know if anyone notices anything unexpected!

**If you've only confirmed the deploy command succeeded (safer/more accurate):**

> 🚀 **Deployment complete** — the deploy command finished successfully (exit code 0) and the new version is live in production. I'm doing a final check now to confirm everything's behaving as expected — will follow up shortly, but wanted to give you a heads up in the meantime.

Let me know which matches your situation, or if you've already confirmed things look good and want me to tweak the tone/channel (Slack, email, etc.).
